verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, cost, and mechanics. Preserve unresolved values as null.
research_scope: Justice Rush — Strike Super acquisition and mechanics research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository exact-name coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Dragon Ball documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Justice Rush was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Justice Rush as a Strike Super Attack.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The documented Xenoverse 2 route is Training with Gohan (Adult) and Videl, specifically Lesson 1. Independent documentation confirms Justice Rush as a Future Warrior skill learned through Gohan and Videl's training.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented route is mentor training rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100; stamina cost remains null because the reviewed canonical sources do not establish a reliable value.

records.name: Justice Rush
records.character_source: Videl / Great Saiyaman 2 / Pan customizable partner
records.skill_description: A Strike Super that briefly poses, then unleashes a sequence of punches and kicks ending in a powerful knockback kick.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference documents a 10-hit short-range barrage: nine strikes followed by a final launching strike. The opening pose can also function as an attack, and the final hit can transition into an Ultimate Attack when the command is entered before the last kick. Exact frame and damage values are not promoted to canonical numeric data.
records.acquisition_notes: Gohan (Adult) & Videl Training Lesson 1 is the documented Future Warrior acquisition route. Historical Xenoverse 1 PQ31 references are retained only as cross-game history and are not used as the Xenoverse 2 unlock route.
records.pve_notes: Mentor-training acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Short-range Strike barrage with a knockback finisher and documented Ultimate Attack cancel window; detailed frame and matchup behavior remains version-sensitive.
